guide.title: How to set up OBS
guide.step1: Use OBS Studio 30 or newer: Settings → Stream
guide.step3: Server: paste the template's server URL
guide.step4: Bearer Token: paste your stream secret
guide.step5: Start Streaming in OBS. You're live on 3Speak.
guide.chatCopy: At the top of this page, under "Your chat in OBS", click "Copy chat URL". It is one link for all your streams.
guide.chat2: In OBS, open the "Docks" menu and choose "Custom Browser Docks". Enter a name like "3Speak chat", paste the URL and click "Apply". New messages show up in that panel while you are live. Viewers never see it.
guide.chat3: Viewers already see the chat next to your stream, so you don't need to put it into the video. Only if you also share the stream somewhere else: add the same URL as a "Browser" source and remove "&dock=1" from its end. Then the messages float over the video and fade out after 30 seconds.
guide.chatOptions: Optional, add to the end of the URL: &max=10 shows fewer lines, &size=18 makes the text bigger, &fade=0 keeps messages on the video.
guide.limitsFree: Free streams end after 30 minutes and show a 3Speak watermark. With 3Speak Pro you can stream for 4 hours without a watermark.
guide.limitsPro: With 3Speak Pro your streams can run for 4 hours and carry no watermark.
